claims: C1 a developer is a customer of the OpenAI API

C2 some developers use the API to add intelligence to their software applications, in which case the assistant's output is consumed by an application and is typically required to follow a precise format
C3 other developers use the API to create natural language interfaces that are then consumed by end users
C4 a developer may act as both a developer and an end user

concepts.name: developer_definition
concepts.gloss: D is a customer of the OpenAI API who may add intelligence to software applications or create natural language interfaces consumed by end users

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: customer_of_openai_api
concepts.gloss: D is a customer of the OpenAI API

concepts.name: application
concepts.gloss: A is a software application that consumes the assistant's output
concepts.inference: the text says the output of the assistant is consumed by an application, so a predicate for that application is needed

concepts.name: end_user
concepts.gloss: U is an end user who consumes a natural language interface created by a developer
concepts.inference: the text distinguishes developers from end users and says interfaces are consumed by end users

concepts.name: adds_intelligence_to
concepts.gloss: developer D uses the OpenAI API to add intelligence to software application A
concepts.inference: the text describes developers who use the API to add intelligence to their applications

concepts.name: creates_interface
concepts.gloss: developer D uses the OpenAI API to create natural language interface I
concepts.inference: the text describes developers who use the API to create natural language interfaces

concepts.name: interface_consumed_by
concepts.gloss: natural language interface I is consumed by end user U
concepts.inference: the text says interfaces are consumed by end users

concepts.name: output_consumed_by
concepts.gloss: the assistant's output is consumed by application A
concepts.inference: the text says the output of the assistant is consumed by an application

concepts.name: output_requires_precise_format
concepts.gloss: the assistant's output is typically required to follow a precise format
concepts.inference: the text says the output is typically required to follow a precise format

ontology.gloss: D is a developer because D is a customer of the OpenAI API
D is a developer because D uses the API to add intelligence to software application A
D is a developer because D uses the API to create natural language interface I consumed by end user U
